title: Mixed Event — Don't lose faith! — Episode3 Our Intense Training Begins

meta.Event Outline: Now that Shiho has passionately declared that they'll let their music do the talking, she and the rest of Leo/need decide to ramp up their practice in the month leading up to their next show. When that proves to be insufficient, Shiho proposes an intense training program in SEKAI!

rows.Line: The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's get started with our first day of training...

rows.Speaker: Honami, Ichika & Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, since this is our first day, I'd like to start by explaining what we'll actually be doing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As you all probably know already, our next show is roughly one month from now and we'll be practicing in preparation for that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: For the next two weeks, Miku and the others will be working with us one-on-one to raise our skill levels for the instruments we each play. Then, for the following two weeks until our show, we'll be working on playing as a band.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, with regards to how we'll be spending each day, we'll gather each morning to report on how we're all doing and break off into pairs for each instrument...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm thinking that we can have evenings to ourselves after each practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So we've got to keep the chatting to a minimum and focus on practicing as much as possible!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sounds like a plan.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yup!
It sounds pretty intense already!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, until the end of these first two weeks, we'll only be working on playing our respective instruments...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And not playing together until the third week, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think we'll know then just how much we've improved individually...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Reuniting once more after spending a long time training...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is so exciting! It's like the story in a manga I borrowed from Tsukasa a while back!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's one of your most endearing qualities, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But please don't forget that we absolutely have to make our next show a success.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because if we don't find a way to get through to that crowd with our next performance, they probably won't give us another chance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Which means...
We won't be able to play at that live house ever again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right...
And I understand that completely.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But, at the same time... I still want us to have fun...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, Leo/need isn't really about sad songs like the one we're working on right now. I believe we're a band that should be playing fun and exciting music!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As important as practicing is, we can't forget that we're trying to reach others through our music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we get to practicing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, mind if I say something before we do?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As we mentioned yesterday, we discussed how we'll actually be teaching each of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll still be teaching you one-on-one, but we thought that we could swap places each day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? Swap places each day...?
Does that mean you're all gonna teach us how to play our instruments?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Being exposed to various styles should allow you to see things from different perspectives, no?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-That's true...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we're already asking so much of you guys. This is turning into one of those buffets where you get to eat as much expensive beef and crab as you like!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not the example I would've chosen...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But are you sure about this...?
We really are asking a lot of you guys. What you're suggesting sounds like a ton of work.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You girls are doing everything you can, so we thought that we should as well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It sounds super fun, so I'm all for it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's make the most of our first day of training! Here... We...

rows.Speaker: Honami & Ichika
rows.Line: Go!
se_event_faith_2022_006

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Good...
I'm playing the part that was giving me trouble just fine now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(But I kinda want a second opinion.
I wonder who's assigned to me today?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I guess I'll just have to wait...
For now, I'll keep practicing and checking off all the things that I need to do.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have to get this perfect and play in a way that really moves everybody in that crowd...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's make that happen...
se_event_faith_2022_007
se_event_faith_2022_007

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (No, I'm not getting this part right. The way I'm playing doesn't match this song's feel.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I won't be able to get through to that crowd if I keep getting stuck in places like this...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I have to find a better sound... A sound that actually goes with this song. Not just for this part. I should take another look at the other parts and...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...? KAITO, when did you...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Please, continue...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Don't mind me...
Please, keep playing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...
se_event_faith_2022_007

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Wait, this is that part from earlier...
No matter how many times I play it, I can't seem to get it to sound right.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Based on this song's feel, it needs to sound more somber. As it stands, I'm plucking too hard, but my bass is gonna lose its presence if I pluck any softer...)
se_event_faith_2022_007

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...!
This sound...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did that seem right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's perfect.
That's exactly what I've been trying to produce...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I have to try copying it before I forget...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It went like...)
se_event_faith_2022_007

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that's it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I'm a lot closer...
But it's not quite what KAITO played just now.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again...!
se_event_faith_2022_007

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Why don't we take a little break...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks to you, KAITO, I was able to figure out how to play the part that was giving me so much trouble. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm glad I could help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (KAITO's so cool and calm...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Also, without realizing it, five and a half hours have passed since I started...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And yet, KAITO doesn't seem tired at all... He probably suggested taking a break for my sake.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (At the same time, there isn't a whole lot else for me to do...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh... The way KAITO plays his bass...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(It's so soothing...
Like being wrapped in a delicate blanket.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I wanna play like that too...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(This is nice...
I hardly ever get to play bass with someone else.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Huh? Did he improvise just now...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (If that's how you're gonna play...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I came to have a peek at how everyone else was...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But Shih and KAITO look like they're doing just fine! I feel pretty lucky too since you don't get to see bass-only sessions all that often...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin, what are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wahhh!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: D-Don't scare me like that, you two!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wasn't trying to.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That sounds like...somebody playing the bass?
So, the people in this classroom are...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They look like they're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, and...
I'm glad that they're not holding back.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Now that you've seen everything, you two know this means we're in cahoots now, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't remember there being a rule that forbade us from seeing what everyone else is doing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Also, Rin, aren't you supposed to be working with Saki? You're not skimping out on your duties, are you...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
B-Break's about to end!
I wasn't skimping! Honest!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I have to get back to Sakki!
I'll see you both later!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, Rin...
Is she really going to be okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku, let's get back to practicing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What? But you just said that you wanted to take a break...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know, but seeing Shiho practice made me want to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's already an incredible musician and trying this hard. That means I need to keep doing everything I can.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'm right behind you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're still going too fast, Honami.
Try focusing more on the snare drum this time and less on the bass drum.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're doing a little too much here and there, Saki. I know this song means quite a lot to you, which in and of itself isn't necessarily a bad thing, but playing the keyboard is very different rhythmically from playing the piano.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You don't need to think about this when you're playing piano solo, but... Try to focus on playing in time with everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: G-Got it...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You seem to fall out of rhythm when you're about to tremolo pick, Ichika. I'm guessing that you're feeling a bit rushed during those parts, but try playing them one note at a time instead.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You're right...
Let me try that one more time...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(It's already this late...
But I can still hear everyone practicing.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It sounds like a mess of different sounds...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But it's also kinda nice...
A few days later
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Humhumhuum♪
Shopping duties with Shiho today♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Someone's in a good mood...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's because we haven't gone out together like this in so long! It's been all practice and no play with us lately!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess so...
But we should get what we need and head back ASAP. The others are probably still practicing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right...!
While we're out buying stuff, Ichi and Hona might be making huge improvements!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's buy what we need and head straight back! We just have to get strings for Ichi and...
Oh, are you out shopping?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-You're...!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to see you two here.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Also, do you usually go shopping at this time? It seems a bit strange.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
We're allowed to go shopping whenever we like.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Yes, that's true, but you didn't seem like the type to go out and about at night is all. Just like the show the other day...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Didn't you say then that you're going to let your music do the talking for you during your next performance...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What about that...?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: I felt that I should go and watch your band since you were willing to say such a thing. Incidentally, I asked the staff at that live house and...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: As it turns out, it's the day my band was also thinking about playing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: So, unfortunately, I won't be able to watch alongside the audience. However...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing your band play. I'll be watching from backstage.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hang on, that means...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: See you then.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
She really only comes in to say what she wants and disappears right after.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh...?
S-Sorry, I think I spaced out for a bit there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to hear that Saku's band would also be playing that day... It kinda startled me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This means we absolutely have to do everything we can until the day of the show!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Is Saki...?)
